test_title: General intelligence and Reasoning Ability Mock Test 75

questions.question: G, H, I, P, Q and R live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on till the topmost floor, which is numbered 6.H lives on floor number 2. Only two people live between H and Q. P lives on a floor above Q. G lives on a floor below H. I lives on an odd numbered floor.Who lives on floor number 4?
In a certain code language, ‘QUST’ is coded as ‘8430’ and ‘TUSZ’ is coded as ‘0489’. What is the code for ‘Z’ in that language?

Two sets of numbers are given below. In each set of numbers, certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number result(s) in the second number. Similarly, certain mathematical operation(s) on the second number result(s) in the third number and so on. Which of the given options follows the same set of operations as in the given sets? (Note: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)16 - 32 - 22;22 - 44 - 34

This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.(Left)  231  638  349  915  564  (Right)(Example - 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)NOTE - All operations to be done from left to right.What will be the resultant if the third digit of the highest number is added to the second digit of lowest number.

'A + B' means ‘A is the father of B’,'A % B' means ‘A is the mother of B’,'A $ B' means ‘A is the sister of B’ and'A - B' means ‘A is the brother of B’.Which of the following means that P is the father of G's father?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (P + Q $ R + G) है।

questions.question: Two sets of numbers are given below. In each set of numbers, certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number result(s) in the second number. Similarly, certain mathematical operation(s) on the second number result(s) in the third number and so on. Which of the given options follows the same set of operations as in the given sets? (Note: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)11 - 33 - 66;15 - 45 - 90

Each of A, B, C, D, E, F and G has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. G answers an exam on Wednesday. E answers an exam immediately after G. Only one person answers an exam after B. C is neither the first nor the last person to answer an exam. F answers an exam on one of the days after G but before B. D answers the exam one one of the days after A. On which day does A answer an exam?

A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. F is sitting 4th to the right of D. Only 2 people are sitting between F and G. E is sitting immediately to the right of D. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
If ‘+’ means multiplication, ‘×’ means division, ‘÷’ means subtraction and ‘−’ means addition, then find the value of the following expression.208 × 16 + 18 ÷ 120 − 14

Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?# : BWP :: VQJ : %
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (# = FAT, % = RMF) है।

questions.question: In this question, a statement is given followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true, and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the given courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.Statement:A study shows that around 60% of the time spent on mobile phones is spent on attending to push notifications and unnecessary pop-up articles. This has led to an increased and unproductive screen time.Courses of action:I. Turning off push notifications and not signing up for newsletters will considerably reduce the screen time.II. All smartphone companies should exclude the feature of 'push notifications' from their next phone models.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Only I follows.) है।

questions.question: What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if ‘÷’ and ‘−' are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘+’ are interchanged?43 + 4 − 4 × 6 ÷ 7 = ?
Which of the following letter-number clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?EC01   JH07   OM13   TR19   ?
In the following series, only one letter-cluster is incorrect. Select the INCORRECT letter-cluster.DWP    GZS    JCV    MFY    PJB    SLE

Nimesh starts from Point A and drives 27 km towards West. He then takes a left turn, drives 25 km, turns left and drives 30 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 39 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (14 km to the South) है।

questions.question: What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?21   36   66   126   246    ?

This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.(Left)  426  753  351  276  631  (Right)(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)NOTE - All operations to be done from left to right.If 2 is added to the first digit of every number, in how many numbers will the first digit be exactly divisible by the second digit?

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:Some paths are roads.No road is a street.All highways are roads.Conclusions:(I) Some path are highways(II) No highway is a street.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Only conclusion (II) follows.) है।

questions.question: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing four people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.In row 1, L, M, N and O are seated, and all of them are facing south.In row 2, R, S, T and U are seated and all of them are facing north.Thus, each person faces another person from the other row.M sits third to the right of L. The one facing R is an immediate neighbour of L. The one facing N is an immediate neighbour of R. The one facing M is an immediate neighbour of U. S sits at some place to the left of T.Who among the following faces U?
How many meaningful four letter English words can be formed using T, U, O and E using all the letters but each letter only once in each word?
